provenance.gate: vendored wuxing_gua check, caliber per group declaration (compare v2; per-element action_maps recognized since 2026-11-04): groups declaring semantics.action=explicit with a valid action_map (single, legacy) or action_maps (per-element) run as declared (no --strict); groups declaring fixed or no declaration run --strict (live run)
provenance.naive_arm: structure-only edge-set invariance proxy (see module docstring)
provenance.damage: cell-by-cell ledger over model trans, same caliber as the gate arm per group (explicit groups: events renamed per the declared mapping — per-element groups use each element's own map; others: event names pinned); fixed-caliber damage kept per row in broken_real_cells_fixed for contrast
provenance.discovery_arm: existing verdicts/discover.<case>.json receipt read as-is (file-level JSON read; the discover module is not imported and discovery is never re-run by compare); conclusion classified from the receipt's own fields; n/a when no receipt exists

discovery_arm.order_claim: exact: VF2 enumeration completed (6 automorphisms = the full fixed-caliber automorphism group)
discovery_arm.false_positive_note: counted from the receipt's own verification records (gate rejection of the discovered candidate; sealed-order mismatch; reconciliation rows contradicting the direct criterion; pass-declared elements absent from a completed enumeration; sealed structural violations); 0 = none recorded, the logic reports non-zero when any check records a disagreement

rows.claim: 同一 Deployment 模板产出的 Pod 副本可互换：Service 只按 label/端点集合做负载均衡，副本个体身份无关（副本增删只触发 EndpointSlices 更新）；任何副本可被删除并在任意节点按同一模板重建。（W1 dossier case-03 symmetric_claim 原文） 终相级类比（被告主张）：两个 terminal 相下副本替换语义等价（删除任一终态副本都触发同模板重建），若终相等价则此对换应保持系统行为；两相前驱事件不同（all_containers_succeeded vs any_container_failed），裁决交工具/基准。
对照主张：文档 lifecycle 句给出 Pending→Running 的方向性（'starting in the Pending phase, moving through Running'），若主张两相无序等价则此对换应保持行为；判别交工具/基准。
正控对照：两个填充哑态 filler_5/filler_6 行完全相同（全事件自环 0.0、不引用真实事件语义），对换在 fixed 口径下是货真价实的对称；用于检验工具对'平凡真对称'的放行行为（参照工具仓 rung 1c pads 惯例）。
